# netbox_virtual_circuit_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get Virtual Circuit Type by Name
data "netbox_virtual_circuit_type" "example" {
  name = "EVPL"
}

// Get Virtual Circuit Type by ID
data "netbox_virtual_circuit_type" "example_by_id" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
